blocks.text: Elements in group 17, known as halogens, are nonmetallic. The term “halogen” means “salt-former” because these elements easily react with alkali metals and alkaline earth metals to form stable halide salts. Examples are fluorine, chlorine, bromine. Halogens are highly reactive nonmetals with high electron affinities. Halogens can easily accept one electron to complete their outermost shell.
